izzyondroid:com.afkanerd.sw0b.summary: Communicate with online services using SMS messaging
izzyondroid:com.afkanerd.sw0b.description:
SWOB ("SMSWithoutBorders", AKA "SMS Sithout Borders") is a platform which enables users with a smartphone to communicate with online third-party platforms using SMS messages.
 A typical use-case of the platforms is sending out emails from platforms such as Gmail accounts. This becomes a useful tool in cases where access to the internet is limited or completely unavailable. Usage of SWOB entails having a proactive approach to maintaining your communications; the features that SWOB supports require the users to take delebrate actions prior to usage.
 Our goal is not to replace the internet; for the most part, the internet is an already efficient method of communication with many abilities that surpass what's possible with simple SMS. Unfortunately, we still have a good portion of telecom users in the world who will have to rely on SMS for tasks built for the internet. Based on value, internet based communications are cheaper than SMS based communications. We are using SWOB on the basis of accessibility of a communication medium.

izzyondroid:com.github.umer0586.droidpad.description:
Create custom control interfaces easily with a simple drag-and-drop and transform your Android device into a remote control for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), WebSocket, MQTT, Bluetooth, TCP, and UDP protocols.

 Drag-and-Drop Control Pad Creation: 
Design your control pads by dragging and dropping components like buttons, sliders, and switches.
 Multi-Protocol Support and Flexible Connectivity:

 For Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) , the app acts as a peripheral (GATT server) , notifying interactions such as button presses, slider changes, and switch toggles via BLE notifications.

fdroid:com.mooneva.app.name: Mooneva Cycle – Period Tracker
fdroid:com.mooneva.app.summary: Private period & cycle tracker. Offline, encrypted, no account, no ads.
fdroid:com.mooneva.app.description:
Mooneva Cycle is a private, fully offline period tracker and menstrual cycle calendar. Track your period, predict your next cycle, follow your fertile window and ovulation, and log daily symptoms and mood — all without an account, and without a single byte leaving your phone.
 Why offline matters 
Most period tracking apps upload your cycle data to company servers, where it can be sold to advertisers, exposed in a breach, or demanded by law enforcement. Mooneva has no servers at all. Your data is encrypted on your device using PBKDF2 and AES-GCM, and the app does not even request the internet permission — there is nothing to transmit, and nothing to hand over.
 Features 
 Period and menstrual cycle tracking with adaptive predictions
 Fertile window and ovulation estimates
 PMS window warnings
 Daily log: mood, symptoms, flow intensity, discharge, sex and libido
 Pill and contraception reminders — pill, patch, ring, injection, IUD, implant
 Trends, cycle history and symptom heatmaps by cycle day
 Clinical PDF report to share with your doctor
 Birth control mode — hides fertility, tags withdrawal bleeds
 Pregnancy mode — pauses predictions and alerts
 Discrete mode — disguises the app as a task list, icon and name included
 PIN lock with configurable timeout
 Encrypted backup and restore
 Import your history from drip, Flo, Clue and SimpleInnovation
 Persian (Jalaali) calendar and full right-to-left support
 Configurable first day of week
 Dark theme
 Available in 14 languages 
English, German, Spanish, Swedish, Chinese, Persian, Arabic, Turkish, French, Ukrainian, Italian, Hungarian, Russian and Portuguese.
 Privacy 
No accounts. No cloud. No analytics, no crash reporters, no advertising SDKs, no third-party services of any kind. Mooneva cannot see your data, because it never receives it.
 Open Source 
Licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Full source code available on GitHub.

fdroid:de.benibela.videlibri.name: Library App VideLibri
fdroid:de.benibela.videlibri.summary: Renews books borrowed from libraries and searchs in OPACs
fdroid:de.benibela.videlibri.description:
VideLibri protects one from missing the due date when borrowing books from public libraries by downloading the list of borrowed books from the library webpage (WebOPAC), renewing all renewable books, and notifying you about non-renewable books, so you do not have to pay late fees to the librarians. Furthermore, the app has all the usual functions of an OPAC.
Features:
- Tested with 200 public and academic libraries in Germany, Switzerland, and Austria.
- Supports 20 different kinds of OPACs from different vendors out of the box.
- Custom XPath expressions can be entered in the app to select any data from any website, so any library can be added without compiling the app.
- It shows all borrowed books from all library cards from different libraries in a single list, so you can always see which book needs to be returned next.
- The list of borrowed books can be sorted by the due date, lending date, lending library, author, title, and other criteria.
- The notification about a dooming due date is more reliable than reminder emails sent by the library OPAC since you can never know if an email actually arrives in time. VideLibri on the other hand stores all data on your smartphone, so the due date is always already there and does not need to arrive.
- Renewing of borrowed books, manually or automatically before the due date to extend the lending period.
- History of all borrowed books, so you can always look back at the books you had borrowed in the past, even after the books were returned to the library and are not shown anymore in the library OPAC.
- Turing-complete XQuery search in the history that can answer arbitrary complex queries, like which borrowed book had the longest title and was borrowed more than once? 
- Search in the OPAC for non-lent books as well as ordering and reserving of non-lent books in some libraries.
- Developed since the year 2006, it is the world's first universal library app and any other library app is a VideLibri copycat.
- Open-source
Some larger public libraries that were tested successfully are for example in the cities Augsburg, GGG Basel, Berlin, Bielefeld, Cologne, Düsseldorf, Lübeck, or Linz, or Munich.
The entire list of all tested libraries and OPACs is too long for the app store page, but you can find it at https://videlibri.de/bibliotheken.html . 
The Android part of VideLibri has been translated into English. However, since most libraries in the list are German, they have German books with German titles. Additional resources like documentation and changelog written for the original VideLibri Windows app in 2006 remain in German. The Windows and Linux app are currently being translated.

fdroid:de.thomaskuenneth.benice.name: Be nice
fdroid:de.thomaskuenneth.benice.summary: Modern aesthetics. Open-source soul. Your Android launcher.
fdroid:de.thomaskuenneth.benice.description:
Be nice is an open source launcher for Android, made for phones, foldables and tablets.
It puts what you use most on your home screen: your favorites, two app widgets and a dock, laid out in Material 3 Expressive and adapting to the size of your screen. Tap the search bar, type a few letters of a name, for example ffx, and Firefox is one tap away.
Features
- Favorites and widgets: Keep your favorite apps, app pairs and folders on one page, with two app widgets, and each widget slot can stack two widgets. Long-press a widget to change, reconfigure or remove it. Swipe down or up to open an app or start the search, as you choose in Settings.
- Made for large screens: On foldables and tablets, additional widgets get their own pane, and Settings arranges its cards in two or three columns.
- Search: Find apps, app pairs, favorites and folders by typing a few letters. If a name matches exactly, only that item is shown, and the Go key opens it.
- App pairs: Launch two apps side by side with a single tap, on phones, tablets and foldables, when the system allows split-screen.
- Folders and favorites: Organize your apps in folders. Long-press an item for favorites, folders, custom labels and more.
- Grouped apps: Apps with several launchers can be shown as one entry. Tap to pick an activity, and favorite whole apps or single activities independently.
- Hidden items: Hide apps from the list and manage them in Settings.
- Dock: Show or hide a dock with up to five slots for phone, messages, browser or your own choices, and pick its color.
- Private space and work profile: Their apps get their own tabs, clearly badged.
Be nice is free, open source and contains no ads or trackers.

fdroid:dev.cena.whyiamhere.name: Why am I here?
fdroid:dev.cena.whyiamhere.summary: Set a goal before opening distracting apps
fdroid:dev.cena.whyiamhere.description:
Use your apps with intention. Choose the apps you want to be more mindful about, then enter a goal and a time limit before using them.
• Set a duration of 5, 15, 30 minutes, or your own value.
• Keep your goal and remaining time visible in a draggable, collapsible widget.
• Use independent timers for different apps and finish sessions early.
• Get a warning before time runs out, then return to the home screen.
• Reuse recent goals stored locally on your phone.
• English, Spanish and Russian follow your system language.
The accessibility service detects the active app, shows the reminder and returns you home when time expires. It does not read screen text, passwords or messages. No internet permission, account, root or separate overlay permission is required. Your settings, goals and sessions stay on your device; Android backup is disabled.
This is a voluntary reminder, not a tamper-proof blocker. An app may appear briefly before the goal form. Background audio can continue after returning home. Background expiry is handled when you return to the app. Changing the phone clock changes the timer. Some manufacturers require battery restrictions to be disabled for the service.

fdroid:dev.linwood.butterfly.nightly.name: Linwood Butterfly Nightly
fdroid:dev.linwood.butterfly.nightly.summary: Take notes, draw freely, and organize ideas across an endless workspace
fdroid:dev.linwood.butterfly.nightly.description:
Butterfly is an open-source app for people who think better with space around their ideas. Instead of writing everything from top to bottom on a fixed page, you get an endless workspace where you can place notes, sketches, diagrams, images, and documents wherever they make sense.
Use it for class notes, meeting notes, research, math, worksheets, planning, whiteboarding, storyboards, product sketches, or any project that starts messy and needs room to grow. Write by hand with a stylus, touch, or mouse, type text and Markdown, add shapes and lines, place images and photos, import PDFs, SVGs, and image files, then export your work as PDF, SVG, images, or portable Butterfly files.
Butterfly tries to stay out of your way while you work. Recent files, quick-start templates, search, folders, imports, page navigation, and tool settings are close when you need them, but the document stays at the center. You can begin with a plain page, ruled paper, a grid, dotted paper, music paper, or your own template.
As your document grows, Butterfly gives you ways to keep it understandable. Split work into pages and page folders, use layers, mark important places with areas and waypoints, save reusable parts in packs, and keep palettes and text styles ready for the next document. Almost everything you add remains editable, so you can move, resize, recolor, reorder, and refine your work later instead of starting over.
Your files stay under your control. Work offline, store documents on your device, choose a different data directory, or connect WebDAV and Nextcloud if you want your own sync setup. There is no required account, no required subscription, and no required proprietary cloud.
Butterfly is free, community translated, available on phones, tablets, desktops, and the web, and developed in public under the AGPL-3.0 license.

fdroid:io.github.all3f0r1.oubliettes.name: Oubliettes
fdroid:io.github.all3f0r1.oubliettes.summary: Dungeon logic puzzle: find the walls from the row and column counts
fdroid:io.github.all3f0r1.oubliettes.description:
Oubliettes is a logic puzzle. Each grid hides a dungeon: work out where every wall is from the clues, with no guessing needed. Every grid has exactly one solution.
 Rules 
 The numbers along the edge give the number of walls in each row and column.
 Monsters and chests are never walls.
 Every monster sits in a dead end, and every dead end holds a monster.
 Every chest is in a treasure room: 3×3 open cells, one chest, one opening.
 Elsewhere, hallways are one cell wide and the whole dungeon is connected.
 Features 
 Campaign: 250 levels that are the same for everyone, in five difficulties (6×6 to 14×14), all open from the start.
 Endless: randomly generated grids in the difficulty you pick.
 Daily: one dungeon a day, open on its day only.
 Tutorial: lessons you solve step by step, one technique at a time, then practise alone.
 Hints that teach: where to look, then why, then which cells.
 Share a solved grid as text, without its solution, and dig the one a friend sent.
 Drag to fill a row or column, undo and redo, progress and history saved after every move.
 Screen reader support, a magnifier and two-finger zoom for large grids, plain digits and a calm mode without animation.
 Endless grids are generated on the device. No ads, no tracking, no account.
 Original medieval music loops and sound effects, with volume sliders.
The app never uses the network: it does not ask for the Internet permission.

fdroid:org.electrum.electrum.description:
Electrum is a libre self-custodial Bitcoin wallet with support for the Lightning Network.
It's secure, feature rich and trusted by the Bitcoin community since 2011.
Features:
• Safe: Your private keys are encrypted and never leave your device.
• Open-source: MIT-licensed free/libre open-source software, with reproducible builds.
• Forgiving: Your wallet can be recovered from a secret phrase.
• Instant On: Electrum uses servers that index the Bitcoin blockchain making it fast.
• No Lock-In: You can export your private keys and use them in other Bitcoin clients.
• No Downtimes: Electrum servers are decentralized and redundant. Your wallet is never down.
• Proof Checking: Electrum Wallet verifies all the transactions in your history using SPV.
• Cold Storage: Keep your private keys offline and go online with a watching-only wallet.
Links:

• Source code: https://github.com/spesmilo/electrum

firefox-addons:981853.name: Redirect Bypasser (WebExtension)
firefox-addons:981853.summary: Avoid redirects and has direct access to the sites you want to visit.
firefox-addons:981853.description:
Useful to avoid frame pages (e.g., Google images, Yahoo, Bing...) , ads, surveys, unwanted redirects...
Features:
* Extract links recursively (every URL found are added to a pop-up overlay while hovering the link to let the user choose the best option in a fast way).
* Decode obfuscated links as "reverse", base64 and hex. (tricks used by some sites to prevent direct access to the original web address).
* Extract web addresses within tag's attributes (e.g. onclick, onmouseover...), text contents and JavaScript: protocol (mostly used to open pop-ups or to show overlays).
* Extract web addresses from plug-ins (useful to open flash games, videos... in a new tab or to get URL of videos, musics...).
* Can handle dynamic content (links that move or hide...) very well.
* The icons are sorted by file extension and auto-set colors based on algorithm used, for the user identify them quickly. As an example, while browsing any site (e.g. Google images) the blue icon was the desired target, another link that show blue icon is likely to be the desired one too.
Demo : https://mozlima.github.io/redirectbypasser/test/test-redirectbypasser.html 
===================
WebExtension version of https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/redirectbypasser/ 
Original developer https://www.github.com/mozlima/redirectbypasser/ 
I only signed and uploaded it on AMO
No more fixes or new features will come (however I'm using it from months without a single problem)

firefox-addons:3017563.name: Passa - Password Manager
firefox-addons:3017563.summary: A secure, zero-knowledge password manager that saves, generates, and autofills passwords with optional encrypted cross-browser sync.
firefox-addons:3017563.description:
Passa is a zero-knowledge password manager that keeps you in control of your credentials.
Your vault is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM before it ever leaves the browser. Passa's servers never see your passwords, usernames, or notes - only you can decrypt your data.
Features:
- Save and autofill logins automatically as you browse
- Generate strong, unique passwords
- Built-in TOTP (two-factor) code generation
- Breach monitoring using Have I Been Pwned k-anonymity (your passwords are never sent)
- Optional encrypted sync to your own Google Drive or Dropbox
- Automatic clipboard clearing after copying
- CSV import and duplicate detection
- Right-click to generate passwords on any field
Zero-knowledge by design: encryption keys are derived from your master password using PBKDF2 (600,000 iterations) and never leave your device. The server stores only a bcrypt hash of a client-derived value - never your master password or vault contents.

firefox-addons:925973.name: Export Tabs URLs
firefox-addons:925973.summary: List open tab URLs and titles, copy them to clipboard or save them to a file. Features: custom format (Markdown, HTML…), RegExp tab filter, group by window/tab group.
firefox-addons:925973.description:
Features
 Include titles : Export Tabs URLs (ETU) provides a default format which displays titles along tabs URLs
 Custom format : optionally, custom patterns can be defined instead of the default "include titles" one (e.g. markdown, html…)
 Group tabs : optionally, exported tabs can be organized into sections grouped by window, by tab group, or by both
 Filter tabs : ETU provides a RegExp-enabled tabs filter
 Limit to current window : optionally, the list can be limited to the current window
 List non-HTTP(s) URLs : optionally, ETU can list each and every tab, including cases where the URL scheme isn't HTTP(s)
 Ignore pinned tabs : optionally, ETU can ignore pinned tabs
Permissions
 Access browser tabs : required to list the tabs
 Storage : required to store settings
How can you help improve this add-on?
 Report bugs and issues on Github : the review section of the Firefox add-ons page is not the right medium to discuss about issues. If you want to make sure that an issue/bug is taken care of, please report it via proper channels.
 If this add-on is useful to you, give it a positive review and spread the word.
If you are not comfortable using Github, drop me a line , any help, in any form is welcome.
